name: Fresh 99% Lean Ground Turkey Breast (Skillet-Browned)
whyItWorks: Ground exclusively from skinless white turkey breast with 99% of fat removed (only 1g fat per serving). Browns into tender crumbles with zero greasy pooling, making it ideal for tacos, white rice bowls, or pasta.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown in a nonstick skillet with 1 tsp olive oil and sea salt, breaking up finely with a wooden spoon.
